svg.title: Core Vue page components
svg.desc: Five panels. 1: PageToolbar with title, .c-icon-button actions and ViewSwitch, holding a FilterBar with a text search, an open FilterSelect, a FilterPicker with two chips, a UserFilterControl chip, the filter panel toggle and clear all. 2: CardDirectory composes PageToolbar, FilterBar and a CardGrid of entity cards with a CardSkeleton. 3: an item browser built from DropZone, PathBar with SelectionMenu, and TileGrid with folder tiles, a selected tile, an uploading tile in a ProgressFrame and a tile with an open DropdownMenu. 4: a UiModal holding a HumHubForm with TextField, SelectField, SubmitButton and a field showing a validation error. 5: a StatusBar toast and module buttons added through an ExtensionSlot.

g.text: Each panel is one composition drawn as a UI sketch; a tag names the component that renders that region.
PageToolbar + FilterBarthe head of every list page
used by People, Spaces, Marketplace, cfiles
FilterBar renders a list’s filter definitions and syncs their values to the URL;
registered types (user, space, topic) build on PickerFilterControl.
CardDirectory= a composition, ready to use
Loads pages, applies filters and keeps per-viewer states (following, member).
Your island composes these parts and owns level, selection and uploads.
e.g. cfiles; ViewSwitch toggles TileGrid / list.
Dialog= a form in a Vue-owned modal
Feedback & extension= small parts used everywhere

svg.text: Hand-maintained SVG. Tag colour = component family; a smaller outlined tag marks a part shown inside a larger composition.
